last_summary: Replication Watch run 9 (gear 1, free `deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash`; no gear-2, no quota error). THREE new validations, three domains, none duplicating an existing card, each traced to a real primary source with a DOI; `synthesis/validations/` 53 -> 56 (files pushed; hourly bake pending). (1) RADIESTHESIA/DOWSING - a Government of Maharashtra groundwater agency (GSDA Solapur; Shaikh & Birajdar, IJSRA 2026, doi 10.30574/ijsra.2026.20.2.1275) ran 72-h pumping tests on 215 borewells (146 dowser-sited, 42 ERT, 27 seismic): dowsing 42% success >500 L/h vs ERT 82% / seismic 78% (chi2=42.7, p<0.001), depth error +/-18.5 m vs +/-3.2 m; success tracks aquifer predictability (R2=0.86; 68% alluvium -> 12% massive basalt), not yield (R2=0.08) - a fourth-country field negative, filed MEDIUM (operational audit, self-selected sites, not blinded). (2) WATER STRUCTURE - Teschke et al. (UNICAMP, Brazil), Langmuir 2026 42(18):12491, doi 10.1021/acs.langmuir.5c06652: independent AFM dielectric-exchange-force profiling + floating-water-bridge Raman reports ~50 nm interfacial clusters enclosed by ~10 nm ice-like II walls (eps~3.6) against bulk eps~80 - the archive's water-structure existence claim confirmed by an instrument sharing no protocol with Pollack's EZ microsphere test; MEDIUM (originating-lab method, fitted inversion, does not settle the diffusiophoresis contest). (3) MAGNETO-CULTURE - ElDoliefy et al. (Egypt), Sci Rep 2026 16(1):19542, doi 10.1038/s41598-026-54832-2: 2 mT field at DC/5/10/15 Hz x 30/60/90 min on anise seed -> germination +25%, vigour-index peak at 5-10 Hz, catalase ~4.5x at 10 Hz, alpha-amylase/protease up at 15 Hz, sod down across all fields; MEDIUM-LOW (lab germination, 2024 precursor by an overlapping group, no blinding, % converges by wk 3). DELIBERATELY NOT FILED (checked against the Yard): the INRS EGU26-3985 dowsing abstract still carries NO per-row numbers (peer-reviewed article still forthcoming - the 09-19 record stands); Radin's 2026 excess-correlation preregistration IS the 09-23 record; the Infinity Turbine Schauberger CFD review IS the 09-28 record; the Delorme biofield EEG paper IS the 09-30 record. FEED: not rebuilt locally (7th confirmation of the lane rule - the sandbox builder regresses corpus-derived sections; the hourly aflinks-cron bake folds synthesis/validations/*.md in with no gate).
